state_machine.state_basis: Logical queue condition is derived from internalCount: INIT before first binding, EMPTY when count=0, PARTIAL when 0<count<capacity, FULL when count=capacity. Reset always forces EMPTY.

states.name: INIT
states.description: First invocation. Capacity is derived once from the actual nonempty one-dimensional buffer length and item type is checked against the buffer element type. No queue operation is performed until initialized.

states.name: EMPTY
states.description: elementCount=0. Dequeue rising edge is rejected with 16#8001; enqueue rising edge is accepted unless reset is TRUE.

states.name: PARTIAL
states.description: 0<elementCount<capacity. Accepted enqueue appends at tail; accepted dequeue removes from head.

states.name: FULL
states.description: elementCount=capacity. Enqueue rising edge is rejected with 16#8002; dequeue rising edge is accepted unless reset is TRUE.

transitions.action: Bind capacity from buffer actual length, initialize head=0, tail=0, internalCount=0, status=16#0000; update edge memories.
Highest priority. Set internalCount=0, head=0, tail=0, status=16#0000. Suppress enqueue/dequeue processing. Update edge memories. Do not overwrite item or buffer contents.

transitions.event: NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND capacity>1
transitions.action: buffer[tail:=item; tail:=(tail+1) MOD capacity; internalCount:=internalCount+1; status:=16#0000; item remains caller value.

transitions.event: NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND capacity=1
transitions.action: buffer[tail:=item; tail:=0; internalCount:=1; status:=16#0000; item remains caller value.
Reject dequeue: status:=16#8001; queue and item unchanged.

transitions.event: NOT reset AND accepted enqueue or dequeue not crossing empty/full
transitions.action: Perform exactly one accepted operation on a rising edge; status:=16#0000.

transitions.event: NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND internalCount=capacity-1
transitions.action: Append item at tail; tail:=(tail+1) MOD capacity; internalCount:=capacity; status:=16#0000.

transitions.event: NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND internalCount=1
transitions.action: item:=buffer[head]; head:=(head+1) MOD capacity; internalCount:=0; status:=16#0000.
item:=buffer[head]; head:=(head+1) MOD capacity; internalCount:=internalCount-1; status:=16#0000.
Reject enqueue: status:=16#8002; queue and item unchanged.

transitions.event: idle, no rising enqueue/dequeue, and reset=FALSE
transitions.action: No queue change. status:=16#0000. item and buffer unchanged.

timer_plan.PT_durations: Not applicable; no IEC timers are required.
timer_plan.reset_conditions: Not applicable; reset clears queue state immediately and performs no timer reset.

priorities: Reset is highest priority and suppresses enqueue/dequeue processing on the same scan.
Only rising edges of enqueue and dequeue request FIFO operations; held levels are idle.
Rejected operations must preserve the logical queue and item value.
Successful enqueue appends exactly one sampled item value at tail.
Successful dequeue removes exactly one front value, writes it to item, and advances head.
Status priority per scan: reset or idle/success = 16#0000; empty dequeue rejection = 16#8001; full enqueue rejection = 16#8002.
Capacity and element-type compatibility are established once from the caller-bound buffer; capacity is the actual array length and must fit in DINT.
Simultaneous enqueue and dequeue rising edges with reset=FALSE are outside the valid domain; the implementation must not silently corrupt queue state. Reset still has priority.
Edge memories are updated on every invocation, including reset scans, so a held request is not retriggered later.

scan_execution_order.1_edge_sampling: Sample enqueue, dequeue, reset, item, and buffer for the current invocation. Compute enqueueRise:=enqueue AND NOT enqueuePrev and dequeueRise:=dequeue AND NOT dequeuePrev. Capture preCount and preItem. Update enqueuePrev:=enqueue and dequeuePrev:=dequeue, including reset scans.
scan_execution_order.2_safety_reset_priority_and_state_transi: First evaluate reset. If reset=TRUE, set internalCount=0, head=0, tail=0, status=16#0000, suppress enqueue/dequeue, and leave item/buffer contents unchanged. Otherwise evaluate at most one valid request edge. Reject dequeue when preCount=0 with status=16#8001 and preserve item/queue. Reject enqueue when preCount=capacity with status=16#8002 and preserve item/queue. Otherwise perform exactly one accepted enqueue or dequeue using circular head/tail updates and set status=16#0000. Derive EMPTY/PARTIAL/FULL from updated internalCount.
scan_execution_order.3_unconditional_top_level_timer_FB_calls: No timer function blocks are required. If future timing diagnostics are added, call them unconditionally at top level outside CASE/IF. They must not gate FIFO state transitions or output mapping.
scan_execution_order.4_unified_output_assignments: Assign elementCount:=internalCount. Assign status from the single selected result of this scan. Write item only on a successful dequeue; otherwise preserve the sampled caller item. Write buffer only on a successful enqueue. No other assignment path may modify outputs.

formal_assertions.formula: G((NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre(elementCount) = 0) -> (status = 16#8001))
G((NOT reset AND rising(enqueue) AND NOT rising(dequeue)) -> (status = 16#0000 OR status = 16#8002))
G((NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND NOT rising(enqueue)) -> (status = 16#0000 OR status = 16#8001))
G((NOT (NOT reset AND rising(dequeue) AND pre(elementCount) > 0)) -> item = pre(item))
G((NOT reset AND NOT rising(enqueue) AND NOT rising(dequeue)) -> (status = 16#0000))
